rasterize_meshes: rasterize a batch of meshes into pix_to_face, zbuf, barycentric coords, and pixel distances
rasterize_meshes_perspective_correct: rasterize meshes with perspective correction enabled for accurate barycentric coordinate computation
rasterize_meshes_cull_backfaces: rasterize meshes with backface culling to only render faces visible to the camera
rasterize_meshes_python: run the naive PyTorch implementation of mesh rasterization for comparison with CUDA version
barycentric_coordinates: compute the barycentric coordinates of a point relative to a triangle given three vertices
